name: PyroomacousticsSimulate
description: Run a pyroomacoustics room simulation on the COMPAS backend from direct geometry (no Speckle). Serializes meshes/Breps, materials, sources and receivers into the geometry JSON payload, POSTs to the backend, polls until done, and returns IR download URLs plus per-pair acoustic metrics (RT60/EDT/C50/DRR). Faces whose mesh has no material are skipped.

inputParameters.name: geometry
inputParameters.description: Room geometry: Mesh or Brep items (flattened). Items without a matching material are skipped.

inputParameters.name: materials
inputParameters.description: Per-mesh material map, aligned with the geometry items. Either a single dict {absorption: float, scattering: float} applied to every mesh, or a list of dicts by index. Meshes with no material entry are skipped.

inputParameters.name: units
inputParameters.description: Units of the geometry and source/receiver coordinates. One of 'm', 'mm', 'cm', 'ft'. Default 'm'.

inputParameters.name: settings
inputParameters.description: Optional dict overriding defaults: {max_order, ray_tracing, air_absorption, n_rays, simulation_mode ('mono'|'foa'), sound_speed, rir_duration}. Defaults: {max_order: 15, ray_tracing: False, air_absorption: False, n_rays: 10000, simulation_mode: 'mono', sound_speed: 343.0, rir_duration: 1.0}.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Boolean trigger. While True the component submits the simulation in the background and streams progress. Set to False to cancel/release, then True again to re-run with the current inputs.

outputParameters.name: ir_paths
outputParameters.description: Download URLs for the generated room impulse response WAVs (one per source-receiver pair).

outputParameters.name: metrics
outputParameters.description: Per source-receiver pair result dicts (source_id, receiver_id, ir_file, acoustic_parameters: rt60/edt/c50/d50/drr/spl).

outputParameters.name: status
outputParameters.description: Final status string ('Completed', error text, or timeout).
